Class StripeService.AssignReferences

public class StripeService.AssignReferences
implements Queueable

Queueable class that creates and manages TransactionReference__c records for Stripe transactions. Extracts Customer, Card, and Transfer IDs from transactions, upserts the corresponding reference records, and establishes StripeReference__c junction relationships. Processes records in batches and chains itself for additional batches if needed.

Methods

public void execute(QueueableContext context)

Executes the queueable job to assign reference data to Stripe transactions. Fetches a batch of transactions, extracts Customer, Card, and Transfer IDs, creates or updates TransactionReference__c records, establishes StripeReference__c junction relationships, and chains itself for remaining batches if needed.

Parameters:
    context – QueueableContext: The context in which the job is executed
